items.text: Service
Renovations for all types of property: project, interior design and works with one single point of contact.
One renovation, one point of contact.

We carry out renovations for all types of property. We plan the renovation and interior design together so that the layout, materials and light are decided before work begins. We then coordinate the professionals and monitor timelines and budget through to handover.
The project is developed with the architecture and interior design studio we collaborate with, and you always have the same person to turn to.
The phases
From the first sketch to key handover

When to renovate
A renovation for every occasion
01Before sellingRenovation quotes for the buyer or small improvements that help you sell. [See property sales](service:venta-estrategica).
02When buyingThe renovation planned before purchase and carried out by us. [See Personal Shopper](service:personal-shopper).
